key_insight: A dual-resonator silver microcavity enhances solid-state photon upconversion by boosting sensitizer absorption and directing upconverted emission.
engineering_relevance: This optical design could help photovoltaics harvest sub-bandgap light, though solar-cell efficiency gains were not demonstrated.
method: Embed a thermally co-evaporated rubrene:PdPC active layer in a planar silver microcavity.
Align a dispersive cavity mode with PdPC absorption at 665 nm and 32° incidence.
Use a second cavity mode to directionally outcouple upconverted emission.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 12-fold absorptance enhancement at 665 nm, alongside 22-fold peak and 4.5-fold integrated enhancements in detected upconversion emission.
watch_item: Angle-dependent resonance and cavity-induced reabsorption may limit practical gains under broad-angle solar illumination.
paper_title: Dual-Resonator Organic Microcavities for Triplet-Triplet Annihilation Upconversion
